messages.subject: error
parts:
Dear INLA users, 
Anyone any idea what this error means? It pops up when I run a model. Verbose=TRUE doesn't provide me any information. 

inla.static: src/inla.c:23509: inla_parse_ffield: Assertion `crwdef->n > crwdef->order' failed.

Cheers, Bram
